events.title: New York Manufacturing Index Pulls Back Sharply But Still Indicates Growth
events.description: A report released by the Federal Reserve Bank of New York on Monday showed a substantial pullback by its reading on regional manufacturing activity in the month of November. The New York Fed said its general business conditions index plunged to 7.8 in November after surging to 25.5 in October.

events.title: Tyson Foods Posts Q4 Loss Despite Volume Growth; Warns On Weak Sales In FY27; Lifts Dividend
events.description: Meat processor Tyson Foods, Inc. reported Monday a loss in its fourth quarter, compared to prior year's profit, while operating income plunged from last year, despite higher sales and volume. Looking ahead for fiscal 2027, the company projects weak sales mainly due to lower Beef volumes. The company also announced higher dividend.

events.title: New York Manufacturing Index Pulls Back Much More Than Expected In November
events.description: A report released by the Federal Reserve Bank of New York on Monday showed a substantial pullback by its reading on regional manufacturing activity in the month of November.

events.title: Bay Street Likely To Open Weak; Inflation Data In Focus
events.description:
Canadian stocks look headed for a weak start on Monday, tracking lower commodity prices. Canada's inflation data is likely to make a significant impact on sentiment. 

The mood is likely to remain cautious with regard to technology stocks ahead of Nvidia's earnings update due on Tuesday, and the Anthropic PBC's listing later this week.

events.title: Dollar Surges On Increased Fed Rate Hike Bets
events.description: The U.S. Dollar surged ahead during the week ended November 13 in the backdrop of market expectations of a larger-than-usual Fed rate hike.  The index touched the highest level since March 2025 amidst hotter-than-expected inflation readings and hawkish comments from Fed officials who signaled willingness to tighten policy more aggressively.

events.title: Eurozone Industrial Production Recovers
events.description: Eurozone industrial production grew for the first time in four months in September, data from Eurostat showed Monday. Industrial output rose 0.2 percent on a monthly basis in September, in contrast to the 0.5 percent decrease seen in August. This was the first increase in four months. The growth was driven by the rebound in durable consumer goods and intermediate goods production.

events.title: FTSE 100 Advances 0.4%
events.description: U.K. stocks gained modest ground in positive territory on Monday, with investors tracking corporate news and weighing the hawkish comments from Bank of England policymakers, while looking ahead to the crucial inflation data due later in the week.

events.title: CAC 40 Up Marginally In Lackluster Trade
events.description:
France's equity benchmark CAC 40 moved in a tight band on Monday as investors looked for directional clues and largely refrained from making big moves.

Weak oil prices aided sentiment a bit.

events.title: DAX Modestly Lower In Cautious Trade
events.description: Germany's equity benchmark DAX drifted lower in cautious trade on Monday as investors awaited earnings update from Nvidia. Lower oil prices and softening bond yields helped limit market's downside.

events.title: Indian Shares End Notably Higher As Oil Prices Hold Steady
events.description: Indian shares rose notably on Monday as steadier oil prices helped investors shrugged off hawkish Fed remarks and expectations for further Federal Reserve rate hikes in the coming months.

events.title: China's Economic Activity Weakens
events.description: China's industrial production and retail sales growth slowed more than expected in October and the downturn in fixed asset investment deepened further but the economy is widely expected to be on track to achieve its growth target this year, driven by strong exports. events.title: Gold Edges Lower On Rate-hike Concerns
events.description: Gold prices fell notably on Monday amid expectations for further Federal Reserve rate hikes in the coming months.

events.title: Oil Prices Edge Lower On Oversupply Concerns
events.description: Oil prices were moving lower on Monday as investors weighed renewed hostilities in the Middle East against signs of strong regional oil supplies.
